user_lists_definition:
SELECT aul.id,
    aul.user_id,
    aul.anime_id AS media_id,
    'anime'::text AS media_type,
    aul.list_type AS status,
    aul.progress,
    NULL::integer AS progress_volumes,
        CASE
            WHEN aul.rating IS NULL THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE aul.rating * 10
        END AS score,
    aul.notes,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS started_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS completed_at,
    false AS private,
    aul.created_at,
    aul.updated_at
   FROM anime_user_lists aul
UNION ALL
 SELECT mul.id,
    mul.user_id,
    mul.manga_id AS media_id,
    'manga'::text AS media_type,
    mul.list_type AS status,
    mul.progress,
    NULL::integer AS progress_volumes,
        CASE
            WHEN mul.rating IS NULL THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE mul.rating * 10
        END AS score,
    mul.notes,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS started_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS completed_at,
    false AS private,
    mul.created_at,
    mul.updated_at
   FROM manga_user_lists mul;
